meta.description:
#hoian #hoianvietnam #danang #thingstodo #vietnamtour 
Hội An , formerly known as Fai-Fo or Faifoo, is a city with a population of approximately 120,000 in Vietnam's Quảng Nam Province and is noted as a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1999.

This video covers the lantern boat ride through the Hoai River in Hoi An province, which is a must-to-do activity while you are in Da Nang.
